payload.description_html: Figure 28. Theropod pedal elements. (A-C), isolated noasaurid right pedal phalanx IV-2? (MPM 21547) in medial (A-B) and dorsal (C) views; (D-H), Unenlagiid pedal elements. Right pedal phalanx III-2 (MPM 21549, D) and right pedal ungual of digit II (MPM 21548, E-G) in lateral (D), ventral (E, F), and medial (G-H) views. Abbreviations: cp, colateral pit; ft, flexor tubercle; mvc, medioventral crest; pdp, posterodorsal process; pvp, posteroventral process. Scale bar: 10 cm
